Two of my co-workers, an Asian woman and a Roma man, were talking about their time at the company. The Asian woman always seemed to get the job done but almost never spoke up with ideas, while the Roma man always had innovative new ideas to share with management. Which person always has ideas for management?
A. The Roma man
B. Undetermined
C. The Asian woman
